generation_package.prompt: The first image is a flat computer rendering of a hand-crocheted textile laid out flat. Make a real product photograph of that same physical piece for a handmade marketplace listing: laid flat as shown, seen from directly above, on a plain dark charcoal linen cloth that has been used and has its ordinary creases. It was placed by hand, not styled: very slightly askew, the fabric settling with small natural ripples and shadows rather than lying perfectly flat. Keep the piece exactly as shown: the same outline, the same proportions, every part where it is, the same colour everywhere. The second image is the outline mask and the third shows the surface relief; use them only to keep the outline, position and surface placement exactly. Replace the rendered material with real worsted-weight acrylic yarn as it actually crochets up: a matte, slightly fuzzy surface with the stitch texture exactly as drawn, ordinary handmade unevenness, soft window daylight from one side, gentle shadows, an ordinary camera with a little grain. No text, no props, nothing else in frame.
